newsitem.title: UK: Siebe up as Kleinwort repeats positive view.
newsitem.headline: Siebe up as Kleinwort repeats positive view.

text.p: Shares in Siebe Plc were among the few gainers in a sharply declining UK equity market on Tuesday, supported by positive comment from Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, dealers said.
The stock was up 17-1/2p or 1.8 percent at 987-1/2 by 1437 GMT on volume of 1.7 million shares, even as the FTSE 100 index traded down 64.8 points at 4,680.3.
Dealers said Kleinwort -- Siebe's broker -- repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, though analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
